# Claude Platform

### June 30, 2026

- We've launched **Claude Sonnet 5** (`claude-sonnet-5`), the next generation of the Sonnet family.

### June 9, 2026

- We've launched **Claude Fable 5** (`claude-fable-5`), alongside **Claude Mythos 5** (`claude-mythos-5`) for invited participants.

### May 28, 2026

- We've launched **Claude Opus 4.8** (claude-opus-4-8), our most capable generally available model.

### April 16, 2026

- We've launched [Claude Opus 4.7](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-7), our most capable model for coding.

### August 5th, 2025

- We've launched [Claude Opus 4.1](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-1), an incremental update to Claude Opus 4.
